thread:
Maya: Onboarding pulsar16b (int4) on Dedicated — seeing intermittent OOMs when requests hit ~2k max_new_tokens. Starts fine, then a few pods report CUDA OOMs and auto-fall back to smaller model.

Jon: Can you paste the error snippet? and which instance type?

Maya: logs below from one of the failing workers:
```
2026-03-20T21:45:23Z ERROR: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total, 28.10 GiB free)
Stack: kv_cache_resize -> allocate_activation_cache -> cudaMalloc
```
Instance: dpx-gpu-16g (NVIDIA H100 80GB partitioned), batch=1, max_new_tokens=2048

Sam: Two quick suspects: (1) fragmentation from repeated KV resizing at long-gen, (2) prefetch + large max_new_tokens causing very large transient allocations. Try lowering max_new_tokens default to 512 and enable slot_compactor.

Sree: Agree. Also try: kv_eviction_threshold=0.6 and prefetch=false for this canary. We saw similar pattern with another 16B model where slot compaction + kv trim fixed OOMs.

Olivia: Note we also saw a small quality regression when we int4-quantized pulsar16b on summarization tests — more hallucinations on long contexts. We should gate any default max_new_tokens change with an eval run.

Maya: Proposed triage plan:
1) Canary change: default.max_new_tokens=512 for pulsar16b int4 variant
2) Runtime flags: slot_compactor=true, kv_eviction_threshold=0.6, prefetch=false
3) Batch policy: max_batch_tokens=4096, soft_batch_timeout=12ms
4) Run eval suite (summarization + instruction-following) vs float16 baseline
5) If quality delta > 1.5% regress, rollback defaults and attempt int8 sweep.

Jon: SGTM. I'll push the canary config and a temp metric to flag hallucination rate. Will also enable a rolling restart window.

deploy-bot: deploy started for config pulsar16b-int4-canary @ 2026-03-20T22:01:02Z

Sam: FYI after a manual reproduce, lowering max_new_tokens to 1024 already prevented the OOM on the same trace. 512 is safer for now.

Olivia: I'll kick off the evals once canary has ~1000 sessions; will attach eval diffs here.

Maya: Thanks all. If canary looks good after 24h we'll update docs and set the tiered default for dedicated customers. :thumbsup:
